    Student activity budget, Tha Prachan: fiscal year 2569 (2026)

    The student activity budget for FY 2569 (2026) is 1,988,223.24 baht, with 58.9% going to the Student Union, as printed in the report.

    Published by
    Budget Monitoring and Auditing Committee for the student union and clubs, Student Council, Tha Prachan
    Release date
    19 March 2026 (the date it was presented to the council in the minutes; the report itself is undated)
    Last updated
    31 October 2026
    Next update
    To be announced
    Period covered
    FY 2569 (2026). The start and end dates of the fiscal year are [not stated] in the report.
    Contact
    TUSC secretariat team, Tha Prachan [shared address to be confirmed]

    Main points

    • The student activity budget for Tha Prachan in FY 2569 (2026) is 1,988,223.24 baht. The report prints 1,970,599.50 baht for FY 2568 (2025).
    • The Student Union has 1,171,383.84 baht (58.9% as printed), against 1,248,164.50 baht in FY 2568 (2025). The largest expense category is the event services contract, 768,775.00 baht (38.67% as printed).
    • The FY 2569 (2026) table lists 8 organisations and the FY 2568 (2025) table lists 10.
    • The minutes of 19 March 2026 record it as a report with no resolution.

    How to use these figures

    What you can do with these figures

    • See how much each body has on its line for FY 2569 (2026) and in the FY 2568 (2025) table.
    • See which projects make up each body's amount.
    • See the shares of the Student Union, the council, the clubs and the Student Affairs Division as the report prints them.
    • See broad kinds of cost.
    • Quote the figures, giving the report page.

    Data sources

    Sources

    • Report - Summary of Student Activity Budget Report, Fiscal Year 2026 (B.E. 2569). By the Budget Monitoring and Auditing Committee for the student union and clubs, Tha Prachan. 18 pages, with no date, signatory or reference number. It is the source of every figure.
    • Council meeting, Extraordinary Session 2, Meeting 1 (19 March 2026). Minutes of the Student Council, Extraordinary Session 2, Meeting 1, academic year 2568, 19 March 2026. Item 4.1 is the report on the student activity budget. The minutes record no resolution on the budget. They are the source of the release date.

    The same numbers are in the budget lines dataset (91 rows), which has a view column saying which of the three views a row belongs to.

    Coverage
    7 bodies with project detail and 1 line for the Student Affairs Division. FY 2568 has organisation lines only.
    Timeliness
    The report is undated. The release date comes from the minutes.

    Committee opinion

    เห็นควรให้สภานักศึกษาฯ องค์การนักศึกษาฯ ชุมนุม และกลุ่มอิสระ ขอรับงบประมาณสนับสนุนในการจัดกิจกรรมเพิ่มมากขึ้นเนื่องจากกิจกรรมนักศึกษาเป็นกลไกสำคัญในการเสริมสร้างทักษะ ประสบการณ์ และความสัมพันธ์ระหว่างนักศึกษา

    In English: the committee considers that the council, the Student Union, the clubs and the independent groups should request more funding for activities, because student activities are an important way to build skills, experience and relationships between students (report page 18; the same opinion is in the minutes, item 4.1).

    Glossary

    Fiscal year (FY) 2569
    The budget year as the report names it, in the Buddhist era (2569 is 2026). Its start and end dates are [not stated] in the report.
    Student Council (TUSC)
    The Thammasat University Student Council, Tha Prachan, which publishes the report.
    Student Union (TUSU)
    The Thammasat University Student Union, Tha Prachan, which has most of the budget.
    Club
    A student club that receives budget. FY 2569 has 4: TPC MUSIC, TPC DANCE, ASA TPC and TU HOST.
    Independent group
    A student group the report lists apart from clubs. FY 2569 has one, TPC Film Club.
    Student Affairs Division
    A university division. It has one line in FY 2569, of 200,000.00 baht.
    Compensation (ค่าตอบแทน)
    Money paid to people, for example staff working outside hours, speakers and referees.
    Running costs (ค่าใช้สอย)
    The cost of services and things used to run an activity, such as food, tents, stages, travel and materials.
    Durable equipment (ค่าครุภัณฑ์)
    Items bought for long-term use.
    [not listed]
    The body has no line in that year's table.
    [not stated]
    The report does not give this information.
